# Candidate Profile — Ananya Subramanian

Location: Boston, MA, USA
Email: ananya.subramanian.ds@gmail.com
Phone: +1 617 555 0133

## Summary

Data scientist with 5 years of experience building ML models for pricing and
retention. Currently a Senior Data Scientist at Northwind Retail.

## Employment history

Senior Data Scientist — Northwind Retail (2022-03 – present)
Owns the churn-prediction model serving 12M customers. Redesigned the A/B
testing framework used across the growth team. Partners with engineering to
ship models to production via a Python/Airflow pipeline.

Data Scientist — Meridian Analytics (2019-06 – 2022-02)
Built demand-forecasting models in Python using classical ML and gradient
boosting. Ran statistical significance testing for pricing experiments.
Presented findings directly to category managers.

Data Analyst — Brightline Insights (2018-01 – 2019-05)
First role out of university. SQL-heavy reporting and dashboarding for the
finance team; built the team's first reusable cohort-retention query.

## Education

M.S. Statistics — Boston University (2016–2018)
B.S. Mathematics — University of Massachusetts Amherst (2013–2016)

## Skills

Python, Machine Learning, Statistics, SQL, A/B Testing, Gradient Boosting,
Airflow, Data Visualization

# Job Description — Senior Data Scientist, Growth Team

Location: Boston, MA (interview is in-person where possible)
Experience level: 4+ years

## Must-have skills

- Python
- Machine Learning
- Statistics
- SQL

## Nice-to-have skills

- A/B Testing
- Causal Inference
- Gradient Boosting

## Role summary

We're hiring a senior data scientist to own modeling for the growth team —
churn, pricing, and retention. The role partners closely with engineering to
ship models to production and with category managers to translate results
into decisions.

## What we're screening for

- Demonstrated ownership of a production ML model, not just notebooks
- Statistical rigor — can defend a significance test, not just run one
- SQL fluency for building your own features and diagnosing model drift
- Bonus: experience designing or running A/B tests end to end
